prompts.male_upper:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Create a corrected RUN sprite sheet for the male TILMO hero. Input 1 is the character identity/style reference; input 2 is the REQUIRED SKELETAL POSE AND LAYOUT GUIDE, not an art-style reference. Paint the character from input 1 over EACH corresponding guide pose from input 2, keeping its joint positions and phase order. Exactly 8 columns by 4 rows, 32 complete separate sprites. Row order N, NE, E, SE. All same male character: silver spiky hair, blue crystal goggles, red scarf, navy tunic, white gold armor, dark boots, empty hands, NO weapons.
IMPORTANT: In the guide orange indicates anatomical LEFT limbs and blue indicates RIGHT limbs. These guide colors identify limbs only; final clothes keep the original reference palette, with near leg lit and far leg shaded so the legs can be distinguished. Follow the guide's extended forward thigh, bent recovery knee and backward push-off leg. Columns 1–4 and 5–8 are opposite leg halves, NOT duplicated poses. The boot must reach forward in the facing direction before it sweeps back; do NOT draw eight variants of the same rear-extended leg. Keep both legs anatomically attached at hips, knees bending naturally. Keep head/torso centered and same size. Preserve guide's compact 3-head-tall chibi proportions, slightly overhead orthographic view for each row. Frame8 must transition naturally to frame1. Polished colorful anime 2.5D painted game sprite style matching input1, no motion blur.
Output ONLY the finished sheet with a genuinely transparent background. Remove all guide marks, skeleton lines, orange/blue limb coding, white guide background and grid marks. No labels, text, shadow, scenery, extra figures, weapons or effects. Each entire figure fits inside its own cell with margins. Wide landscape composition.
